column1: # Test recordings from the University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples (https://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/MIS.html).
# "Freely available ... may be downloaded and used for any projects, without restrictions." Downloaded at build time, not stored in the repository.
# Read by the downloadSamples task in app/build.gradle.kts and by SampleValidationTest. Paths are relative to
# https://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/sound files/ and the file name states the note (see flags for exceptions).
# kind: STEADY (no vibrato), VIBRATO, PLUCKED (struck or plucked, dies away). transposition: the instrument's usual one in semitones.
# flags: octave-jump = the player's tone really jumps up an octave for a moment (checked by ear).
# known-failure = a real detector error that remains (see docs/research/RESEARCH_LOG.md); run and reported, not failed.
# The first 42 lines are the original set; the rest (added November 2026) cover every instrument of the collection with
# its lowest, highest and two middle notes at ff, plus the lowest and highest at pp where available.
